scripts.verify: vp check && vp run -r test && eslint --max-warnings 0 . && syncpack lint && vp run textlint && vp run yomiyasu && vp run renovate && vp run actions-lint && vp run -r steiger && vp run -r db:check && vp run -r fallow
scripts.yomiyasu: node -e "const { execFileSync, spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const { path } = JSON.parse(execFileSync('skills', ['ls', '--json'])).find(({ name }) => name === 'yomiyasu'); const statuses = JSON.parse(spawnSync('textlint', ['--format', 'json', '**/*.md']).stdout).map(({ filePath }) => spawnSync('python3', [require('node:path').join(path, 'scripts', 'yomiyasu_lint.py'), '--strict', filePath], { stdio: 'inherit' }).status); process.exitCode = statuses.every((status) => status === 0) ? 0 : 1"
scripts.fallow: fallow --production --quiet --format compact && fallow dead-code --no-production --quiet --format compact && fallow dupes --quiet --format compact && fallow security --fail-on-issues --quiet
